parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: The MAC address of an associated device.

parameters.name: OperatingStandard
parameters.description: The operating standard that this associated device is connected with. {{enum}} {{deprecated|2.15|because this information cannot be obtained by EasyMesh}} {{obsoleted|2.17}} {{deleted|2.18}}

parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: Whether or not this associated device is currently present on the Wi-Fi Access Point device. The ability to list inactive nodes is OPTIONAL. If the Access Point devices includes inactive nodes in this table, {{param}} MUST be set to {{false}} for each inactive node. The length of time an inactive node remains listed in this table is a local matter to the CPE. {{deprecated|2.15|because this information cannot be obtained by EasyMesh}} {{obsoleted|2.17}} {{deleted|2.18}}

parameters.name: AssociationTime
parameters.description: Date and time in UTC when the device was associated.

parameters.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
parameters.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the associated device.

parameters.name: LastDataUplinkRate
parameters.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the associated device to the access point.

parameters.name: SignalStrength
parameters.description: An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the Associated Device (STA) to the Access Point (AP) measured in {{units}}. RCPI threshold is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}.

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: An indicator of the average radio noise plus interference power measured on the uplink from the Associated Device (STA) to the Access Point (AP). Encoded as defined for ANPI in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.10.9.4}}.

object.description: Object describing a single Associated Device (STA). {{deprecated|2.15|because it has moved {{param|AssociationTime}}, {{param|Noise}} into {{object|#####.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.STA.{i}.MultiAPSTA.}} and the remaining parameters are duplicated in {{object|#####.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.STA.{i}.}} except {{param|OperatingStandard}} which was deprecated as noted}} {{obsoleted|2.17}} {{deleted|2.18}}
